channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dennis Lindsey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dennis Lindsey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Royce O'Neale on Dennis Lindsey
item.description:
Eric Walden:Jazz forward Royce O'Neale, on Baylor's national championship:

“Me and Dennis [Lindsey] are gonna rub it in everyone's faces for a little while.”

Royce O'Neale on Dennis Lindsey, Apr 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on finding a player in Ersan Ilyasova who brings similar traits to Bogdanovic and Niang:

“Dennis and Justin and our group wouldn't have looked at someone you couldn't plug and play. I think the one thing we've been really conscious of is the chemistry of the team.”

Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Andrae Patterson on Dennis Lindsey
item.description:
Andrae Patterson, who worked in Utah from 2015-17 as player personnel/player programs coordinator, reached out to me Thursday night.

“My experience and interactions as well as my training with Dennis Lindsey has always been about being respectful and as much of an anti-racist in personal and business life whenever possible,”

Andrae Patterson on Dennis Lindsey, Feb 27, 2021. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Elijah Millsap
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Elijah Millsap accusation:

“I've never heard anything remotely close to that said by Dennis.… And I'm sensitive to things like that — so I'd remember something like that. I've never heard anything like that come out of his mouth.”

Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Elijah Millsap, Feb 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: George Hill on Dennis Lindsey, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Bucks PG George Hill:

“I love Utah. ... My teammates was an awesome cast to play with. ... I felt like I was going to be here, but it didn’t work out. That’s no knock to the organization, ‘cause they have my utmost respect. Dennis Lindsey and Quin Snyder, I love them to death.”

George Hill on Dennis Lindsey, Quin Snyder, Nov 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Justin Zanik on Dennis Lindsey
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Quin Snyder comment on new roles for Dennis Lindsey and Justin Zanik:

“I greatly appreciate working with Dennis and Justin and our entire basketball operations department. Having continuity with good people is certainly a positive and look forward to our continued work together.”

Justin Zanik on Dennis Lindsey, May 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Steve Starks on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik
item.description:
“We are excited for these promotions as they further enable Dennis to provide executive leadership and overall strategic vision for Jazz basketball operations and give Justin the opportunity for greater impact on our organization. As one of the brightest young executives in the league, Justin will be responsible for the day-to-day operations. Their leadership allows us to work collectively toward our championship goals,”

Steve Starks on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, May 10, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Dennis Lindsey, Rudy Tomjanovich
item.description:
Morey continues to insist that it was as much Alexander’s ideas as his own.

“From the moment I interviewed here, to the people that were here before, like Dennis Lindsey (now the Jazz GM), and Rudy (Tomjanovich), they’ll tell you this is how he always felt like basketball should be played,”

Daryl Morey on Dennis Lindsey, Rudy Tomjanovich, Jan 9, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Neff told The Tribune on Wednesday.

“One, George likes it in Utah. Two, George has a close relationship with Gordon Hayward [both are Indianapolis natives]. Three, [Jazz general manager] Dennis Lindsey was largely responsible for bringing George to San Antonio. George has worked with [Jazz coach] Quin Snyder. This is one of the teams George has always wanted to play for.”

Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder, Jun 22, 2016. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Sean Marks on Dennis Lindsey
item.description:
“I know I have a long way to go, but I have a great stepping stone now with the opportunity I have had to learn from Pop, Danny (Ferry), Dennis (former assistant GM Dennis Lindsey). “The way R.C. handles it is amazing: He says, ‘Here, have fun with it; it’s your team, run it. He doesn’t micromanage, and until he gets sick of me asking question after question, I’ll keep picking his brain.”

Sean Marks on Dennis Lindsey, Nov 28, 2012. Source: San Antonio Express-News.
